ease-out.$description: The system's one easing curve. No springs, no bounces, nothing decorative.

dur-fast.$description: Press/tap feedback only — a button, toggle or switch moving to its neu-inset pressed state.

dur-base.$description: Everything else that transitions or animates — panel reveals, glass-surface entrances, hover states. There is deliberately no slower duration.

rules: Every transition/animation must reference dur-fast, dur-base or ease-out — no ad hoc duration or easing values in component CSS.
Wrap all motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and disable or drastically shorten it there; this system has no motion that is load-bearing for comprehension.

_notInDtcgExport.why: No DTCG $type covers a keyframe animation. See tokens.css for the actual @keyframes rule(s).
